explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and at D2 it is non-zero only when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by the common transition. That D2 is 9-10 when the previous trial was an unrewarded rare trial (a1 that landed in S2, and this trial D1 shows no reward); it is about 3-5 when the previous trial was also a common a1-to-S1 trial (unrewarded or just rewarded), about 2-3 right after switching from a2, and 0-1 after a rewarded rare S2 trial or a run of rewarded S1 trials.
